profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Proven expertise in blending coding, infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and DevOps practices to deliver robust technology solutions. Currently serving as a Lead Software Engineer, leading a DevSecRegOps team focused on cloud-based solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently, I serve as a Lead Software Engineer at USAA, leading a DevSecRegOps team focused on cloud solutions for the Life Insurance domain. 

My past roles include acting Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) and leading the end-to-end implementation of multiple solutions, encompassing both coding and infrastructure development.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Site Reliability Engineering · Software Development

positions.title: President, Trinity Tour Guide Association
positions.description:
Joined the organization as a Tour Guide in January 2009
Promoted to Vice President of Membership in August 2010
Promoted to President in January 2011

In charge of recruiting new members, training current guides, scheduling guides for tours, giving tours myself, facilitating communication amongst guides, and dealing with any other issues that may arise.

positions.title: Student Worker, Business Office
positions.description: Did general tasks such as filing, sorting mail, creating labels, and other various tasks in the Trinity University Business Office.

positions.title: Programmer Intern
positions.description: Managed and updated existing application in the company in addition to developing my own project (gathered requirements, created and managed needed databases, created and demonstrated a prototype, began work on final application based on feedback).
